newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Bulbank eyes 34 pct of Central Co-op Bank.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Bulbank eyes 34 pct of Central Co-op Bank.

text.p: Bulgaria's state-owned Bulbank is planning to acquire around 34 percent of the Central Co-operative Bank (CCB), Bulbank's 's chief executive director said.

"Bulbank has decided to acquire some 34 percent of the Central Co-operative Bank to support farm-oriented financing. But we do not have ambitions for a majority stake," Chavdar Kanchev told a news conference.
The CCB's paid-in capital amounted to 1.2 billion levs at end-December and was distributed among local co-operatives and agricultural firms, CCB figures showed.
Its statutes provide for co-operatives to hold at least 51 percent of the capital through their branch organisation, the Central Cooperative Union (CCU).
The CCB is expected to raise capital to five billion levs at its annual shareholders' meeting due at the end of March. -- Roumiana Tikholova, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
